SSD Library Media Center Policies

SMS Library Catalog

  1. Click on the image above to access the library catalog.
  2. Click on Sherwood Middle School.
  3. Search the library catalog by keyword, title, author, topic or more.
  4. Students may sign in with Google to place items on hold or review books.
  5. Choose Log In in the upper right-hand corner.
  6. Click Sign in with Google and use your school account login and password.

It’s easy to place a hold!

  1. After finding the book you want, simply click on the Hold button.
  2. When your book is ready for pick up library personnel will send you an email or note to class.

Having Chromebook trouble?

Scan this QR code or click on this link for tips on how to troubleshoot issues with your Chromebook yourself. If a student can’t seem to reconcile the issue themselves, please bring the device into the SMS Media Center during school hours.

Library personnel will take a look and try to assist you. If your device can’t be repaired in the library, the device will then be sent to the Technology Department for repair. Loaner Chromebooks are available for use while repairs are in process.

Jennifer Reilly

Media Center Educational Coordinator

jreilly@sherwood.k12.or.us
